turns.text: Lloyd, did you see that email from Patricija Žemaitytė? I couldn't find her anywhere online to verify the contact info.
I haven't received that email. Did you check her professional networks?
I just checked, and it turns out Patricija Žemaitytė has a LinkedIn profile. That explains why my initial search failed.
Ah, that makes sense. LinkedIn profiles are often more robust than personal websites.
Yeah. Anyway, while I'm on this topic, can you remind me where I saved the invoice for the server rack?
I don't have access to your local files, but if you used the standard naming convention, it should be in the 'Finance/2026_Q2' folder.
Found it. Thanks. Also, the weather in Vilnius is supposed to be rainy all next week, right?
Yes, forecasts indicate consistent rain for the first half of next week.
